zh.askTitle: 换成你们的身份、收入和孩子情况，去台湾的居留路线和单收入预算就按你们的情况重排
zh.runTitle: 香港夫妇带 2 岁女儿 2027 年中搬台北：他远程工作月薪 48,000 港元，她是护士，储蓄 120 万港元

fields.label: 资料
fields.value: 一对三十代中的香港夫妇，带一个 2 岁的女儿

fields.label: 资料
fields.value: 他是 UX 设计师，为香港雇主远程工作，月薪 48,000 港元

fields.label: 日期
fields.placeholder: 例如：孩子 2025 年 3 月出生

fields.label: 住处及照顾需要
fields.placeholder: 例如：在大安、中山或内湖租两房，女儿读公立幼儿园

fields.label: 汇率及每月预算
fields.placeholder: 例如：1 港元兑 4 新台币，每月预算 17 万新台币

zh.template: 帮我们这个香港家庭规划{date}搬到台湾的居留和单收入预算。护照及身份是{status}，数位职责和税前薪资证明{duties}，护理学历及临床纪录{nursing}，孩子生日{birthday}，储蓄及保留备用金{savings}。先评估数位金卡，再安排港澳家属居留，并行评估她的专业资格居留，只把台湾雇主就业当后备。比较{home}，确认工作、健保和入学缺口，并在不计护理收入及补助下压力测试{fx}。联系他人、分享文件、申请或付款前，先问我。

phases.title: 查港澳居民适用的居留路线、健保、护理执业、幼儿园和租房资料
phases.note: 数位金卡、港澳家属居留、全民健保、护理师考试、台北公私立幼儿园费用和租房例子
phases.judgment: 它没有把“够格”当成理所当然：月薪 48,000 港元只是在汇率不低于约 3.33 新台币兑 1 港元时，数字上才达到金卡 16 万新台币的薪资门槛，还要看数位职责和薪资证明；也不能承诺金卡能直接换永久居留；至于配偶能否在台工作，官方一般规定查到了，但对“港澳身份配偶”是否适用没查实，就如实写明不确定，没有硬套。

phases.title: 写有出处的英文指南，做可重算的预算
phases.note: 推荐路线先后顺序、居留路线对比表，以及每月约 175,600 新台币（约 43,900 港元）的预算，汇率按 4.00 假设

phases.title: 独立核对算术和说法，测电脑和手机版式
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事把预算、汇率换算、租金、储备和税的算术都重算了一遍，没有数字要改，并列出还没落实的缺口。指南里还主动写明一处违规：部分公开网页是经一个已有的浏览器窗口读取的，违反了“只用干净浏览环境”的要求，如实披露，没有说自己合规。

workers: 读台湾移民署、陆委会和数位金卡的官方规定，整理港澳家庭适用的居留路线、文件和时限
查全民健保的投保资格、保费和等待期，以及香港注册护士能否在台考照
查台北市官方的幼儿园入学资格和收费，并记录四个带日期的租房例子
独立复核：重算每个金额，对照来源清单检查指南里的说法

en.askTitle: Swap in your own status, income and child details and the Taiwan residence route and one-income budget are re-planned for you
en.runTitle: A Hong Kong couple with a 2-year-old moving to Taipei in mid-2027: he works remotely on HKD 48,000 a month, she is a nurse, HKD 1.2 million in savings

fields.label: details
fields.value: A Hong Kong couple in their mid-30s with a 2-year-old daughter

fields.label: details
fields.value: He is a UX designer working remotely for a Hong Kong employer at HKD 48,000 a month

fields.label: home/childcare needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. a 2-bedroom in Da’an, Zhongshan or Neihu, daughter in public preschool

fields.label: FX and monthly budget
fields.placeholder: e.g. TWD 4.0 per HKD and a TWD 170,000 monthly budget

en.template: Help our Hong Kong family plan Taiwan residence and a one-income move for {date}. Our passports/status are {status}, digital duties and gross salary evidence {duties}, nursing education/clinical records {nursing}, child's birthday {birthday}, savings and protected reserve {savings}. Assess Digital Gold Card first, HK-family residence next, her professional-residence route in parallel and Taiwan employment only as fallback. Compare {home}, confirm work/NHI/admission gaps, and stress-test {fx} without nursing income or subsidies. Ask before contacting anyone, sharing documents, applying or paying.

phases.title: Research residence routes for Hong Kong residents, health insurance, nursing licensing, preschool and rent
phases.note: Digital Gold Card, Hong Kong-family residence, National Health Insurance, the nursing exam, Taipei preschool fees and rental examples
phases.judgment: It did not treat eligibility as a given: HKD 48,000 a month clears the Gold Card’s NT$160,000 salary bar only if the exchange rate is at least about 3.33 TWD per HKD, and digital duties and salary evidence still matter; it also would not promise permanent residence from a Gold Card; and for spouse work rights it found the general rule but could not confirm it applies to a Hong Kong-status spouse, so it states the uncertainty rather than assuming.

phases.title: Write a sourced English guide and a recomputable budget
phases.note: Route order, a residence comparison table and a monthly budget of about TWD 175,600 (about HKD 43,900) at an assumed 4.00 rate

phases.title: Independently verify the arithmetic and claims, and test desktop and phone layout
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed the budget, currency conversion, rent, reserve and tax arithmetic: nothing needed changing, and the remaining gaps were listed. The guide also owns up to a breach of its own rules: some public pages were read through a browser window that already existed, against the instruction to use only a fresh, signed-out browser, and this is disclosed rather than presented as compliant.

workers: Read Taiwan’s immigration, Mainland Affairs Council and Gold Card rules to map the residence routes, documents and timelines for a Hong Kong family
Checked National Health Insurance eligibility, premiums and waiting periods, and whether a Hong Kong registered nurse can sit the Taiwan exam
Checked official Taipei preschool admission rules and fees, and logged four dated rental examples
Independent check: recomputed every money figure and tested the guide’s claims against the source list
